description.value:
You explode into motion to land a killing strike. You must be wielding a melee weapon you're proficient with, or the power fails. As part of the action used to cast it, you dash in a straight line to an unoccupied space within range and attack a creature within your weapon's reach; any opportunity attacks provoked by the movement are made with disadvantage. The target must succeed on a Dexterity save or take damage equal to three rolls of your weapon's damage dice plus 4d4 force damage, halved on a successful save.

Force Potency. Cast with a force slot of 4th level or higher, the force damage increases by 1d4 for each slot level above 3rd.
